risk_summary: The excerpt is generally quantitative and transparent, reporting revenue, earnings, asset, margin, client-loss, and repurchase metrics. Risk tone is mixed: profitability and operating margins remain strong, but earnings declined, LSV performance weakened, and client losses, fee compression, market sensitivity, and COVID-19 effects remain material risks. Boilerplate forward-looking disclaimers and repeated cause-and-offset phrasing modestly reduce clarity.
